question: Should ClickClack core ship and maintain this six-format artifact viewer and its browser parsing dependencies?
rationale: The engineering defects and proof requests are resolved, but the patch creates a substantial new product surface and continuing parser-security responsibility that requires maintainer sponsorship.

options.title: Sponsor full viewer
options.body: Accept all six formats with the current safety invariants and regression coverage as an ongoing core responsibility.

options.title: Narrow initial formats
options.body: Defer DOCX conversion or syntax highlighting to reduce dependencies and attacker-controlled parsing exposure.

options.title: Keep download-only
options.body: Decline the new core viewer boundary and retain hardened downloads for document formats.

recommendation.title: Sponsor full viewer
recommendation.body: Accept all six formats with the current safety invariants and regression coverage as an ongoing core responsibility.

likelyOwner.reason: His initial release commit owns the current attachment, image-viewer, and chat-shell behavior being expanded.
